mapper.sql: SELECT p.plan_id, p.plan_code, p.plan_name, p.plan_type, p.plan_year, p.target_persons, p.total_hours, p.plan_status, p.enterprise_id, p.status, p.del_flag, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_safety_training_record r WHERE r.plan_id = p.plan_id AND r.del_flag = '0') AS record_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_safety_training_attendee a INNER JOIN biz_safety_training_record r ON a.record_id = r.record_id WHERE r.plan_id = p.plan_id AND r.del_flag = '0' AND a.del_flag = '0') AS attendee_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.hours), 0) FROM biz_safety_training_record r WHERE r.plan_id = p.plan_id AND r.del_flag = '0') AS completed_hours, (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN a.is_pass = '1' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) END FROM biz_safety_training_attendee a INNER JOIN biz_safety_training_record r ON a.record_id = r.record_id WHERE r.plan_id = p.plan_id AND r.del_flag = '0' AND a.del_flag = '0') AS pass_rate FROM biz_safety_training_plan p
mapper.delete: UPDATE biz_safety_training_plan SET del_flag = '2' WHERE plan_id = #{planId}
UPDATE biz_safety_training_plan SET del_flag = '2' WHERE plan_id IN #{planId}
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_safety_training_plan SET plan_status = #{planStatus}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() WHERE plan_id = #{planId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_safety_training_record WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND del_flag = '0'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_safety_training_attendee a INNER JOIN biz_safety_training_record r ON a.record_id = r.record_id WHERE r.plan_id = #{planId} AND r.del_flag = '0' AND a.del_flag = '0'
